_about: Basemap for one precinct. Streets: NYC Open Data Centerline (inkn-q76z), streets, highways, road bridges and ramps, clipped to the precinct's bounding box plus 1,000 ft. Outlines: Police Precincts (y76i-bdw7); 'outline' is full resolution, 'neighbors' are other precincts clipped to the box. Coordinates are [lon, lat]. Label angle is degrees counter-clockwise from due east on a north-up map (before rotDeg), kept between -90 and 90 so text reads left to right. contextBbox covers any page frame of aspect 0.6-1.8 (rotated by rotDeg) around the precinct plus an 8% margin; contextStreets are the streets in contextBbox outside bbox, simplified harder (far minor streets may be dropped); neighbors are every other precinct in contextBbox (about 20 ft outlines, clipped), neighborLabels a point inside each.
